reply_text:
Two findings in `search-filters` against `main`:

*CRITICAL*
• *SQL injection — `src/query.js:11–13`.* The search term is interpolated directly into SQL. A term of `' OR TRUE --` bypasses the category/in-stock filters; even `O'Reilly` produces invalid SQL.
  *Fix:* Push `%${term}%` into `params` and use `name ILIKE $${params.length}`. Add tests asserting exact SQL and parameters for apostrophes and injection payloads.

*INFORMATIONAL*
• *Sort whitelist accepts inherited properties — `src/sort.js:8`.* `orderBy('constructor')`, `orderBy('toString')`, and `orderBy('__proto__')` produce invalid SQL instead of falling back to relevance.
  *Fix:* Check `Object.hasOwn(SORTS, sort)` before lookup, or use a `Map`. Add regression tests for those keys.

All 5 existing tests pass; I reproduced both issues directly. No files changed. I’d block the merge on the SQL injection.
